topic: Largest official gold reserves by country
title: Biggest national gold reserves
subtitle: Official gold reserves, tonnes
hook: Which country holds the most gold? 🪙
fact: The US holds more official gold than Germany and Italy combined, about 8,133 t versus 5,801 t.

captions.instagram:
Gold is still a pillar of national wealth. 🪙 The top 4 holders are the US, Germany, Italy and France, and the US holds more than the next two combined.

Which country do you think will be next to join this club? Tell us in the comments! 👇

Source: World Gold Council / IMF (2026)
